CONTROLS.NAME: drips
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Changes the simulation to make it more drippy.

CONTROLS.NAME: slicing
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Automatically slice the simulation on the beats in the music.

CONTROLS.NAME: stretching
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Vertical and horizontal stretching in time with the music.

CONTROLS.NAME: distort
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Adds a slow lens distortion. Add vertical or horizontal mirrors for best effect.

CONTROLS.NAME: circle_on
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: If on, only center circle will be 'fiery'.

CONTROLS.NAME: color_palette
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Choose from one of three color palettes.

CONTROLS.NAME: no_shading
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Default scene has a darker, subtly audio reactive shading. Turn this up to use full-color, no shading.

CONTROLS.NAME: down_sweep
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a sweep through the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: up_sweep
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a sweep through the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: left_sweep
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a sweep through the simulation.

CONTROLS.NAME: right_sweep
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Send a sweep through the simulation.
